reason: I'd probably play with the free demo, because I do like a streak and I'm curious about an agent doing the boring rebalancing. But I won't sign up to pay for an AI in a cartoon pet handling my real money when there's no named broker and no price yet.
objection: A Tamagotchi feels unserious for money. My retirement savings are in there, and I don't want my real money run by a toy from an app I can't check up on.
would_change_my_mind: A few months of the demo agent behaving well inside my limits, and then a named, regulated broker holding the money with SIPC coverage, at a set price under about $10 a month.
